content: COBS: PyPI 'cobs' package (1.2.2) has C extension + pure-Python fallback, MIT licensed, encode/decode + COBS/R variant. npm 'cobs' package (0.2.1) last published 2014, effectively unmaintained -- avoid; hand-roll (~15-20 lines) if a JS deframer is ever needed. COBS guarantees bounded overhead (1 byte/254-byte block) and resync on next 0x00 delimiter after corruption, beating SLIP and length-prefixed framing for a lossy byte pipe.
